_help: Companies we have a partner agreement with, shown at /partners/ and as a small card on the home page. 'link' is our partner link, 'logo' a file in src/assets. 'points' are plain-text facts from the partner's own pages, each with its 'source'. Every partner link carries rel="sponsored" (invisible to readers; Google asks for it on paid links).

partners.name: Fintiba
partners.tagline: Blocked account and health insurance for Germany
partners.intro: Most international students need a blocked account (Sperrkonto) for a German student visa: proof that you can pay your living costs. Fintiba opens it online before you travel.

points.text: For most students in 2026 the required amount is €11,904 for 12 months. The money stays blocked until you arrive, then €992 is paid each month into your German bank account.
The blocked account, Mawista Visum travel health insurance at no extra cost, and Barmer public health insurance from the start of your semester.
The blocked account, Mawista Visum travel health insurance and Mawista Student private health insurance.
Fintiba Transfer, run with TransferMate, lets you fund the account in more than 140 currencies by bank transfer or card. An ordinary international transfer can take up to two weeks.
Fintiba refunds the blocked amount, minus the account opening fee and any transfer fees.
Fintiba charges a one-time set-up fee and a monthly fee once the money arrives. Its blocked-account page shows the current amounts.
